description: This header file defines object tracking mechanisms for kernel objects in Zephyr OS, including global variables for tracking lists of objects like timers, semaphores, mutexes, stacks, message queues, mailboxes, pipes, queues, and events. It also declares functions and macros for initializing and managing these tracking lists, conditioned on configuration flags.

methods.description: Initializes a kernel timer object for tracking.
